sentences.en: He loosened the knives at his hip and thighs before drawing on the protective gloves and tugging the protective hood and face combo over his head.

sentences.en: Big eaters will enjoy the fajita combo for two and the bottomless basket of chips and salsa.

sentences.en: I'm gonna do it this time, she told him with a grunt as she unleashed a kick-punch-kick combo into the bag.

sentences.en: A good combo is wash using hydrogen peroxide - this will kill off anything on the surface, then sprinkle with antibiotic powder.

sentences.en: As you begin planning your trip, bookmark these sites to look for deals such as free admission days for so many paid days, hotel and park combo specials, and park restaurant offers.

sentences.en: A typical combo plate sells for five dollars and includes a number of island favorites, including Hawaiian Kalua Pork and Korean Short Ribs on a bed of fresh island cabbage, plus two scoops of rice, and a scoop of macaroni/potato salad.
sentences.vi: Một đĩa kết hợp điển hình được bán với giá 5 đô la và bao gồm một số món ăn được yêu thích trên đảo, bao gồm Thịt lợn Kalua Hawaii và Sườn ngắn Hàn Quốc trên một lớp bắp cải đảo tươi, cùng với hai muỗng cơm và một muỗng salad mì ống / khoai tây.

sentences.en: Select from dozens of types of sushi, or pick a combo or box meal such as a bento box.
